scope_contract.reason: The entry creates a parser, adds the supplied string, checks its error, and is responsible for freeing it. Parser lifetime is within this target's execution contract on both source versions.

feasible_trigger.reason: The entry passes nonempty input to ucl_parser_add_string, which delegates to ucl_parser_add_string_priority. That delegate is not supplied, so no finite input is shown to produce a reported error on either version.

observable_consequence.reason: Conditional on a reported error, the entry returns before its only parser-free call. Both versions of parser_free release the parser allocation; the after version also releases last_comment. Whether this consequence occurs for an actual input remains unknown.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry has no cleanup call on the reported-error path and no later call sequence after its return. The added after-version cleanup in parser_free cannot run on that path.

identity_preserved.reason: The same tuple—freeing the parser before returning on a reported add-string error—is assessed against the same old harness on both versions. The harness's early return and add-string delegation are unchanged.

missing_information: Both versions of src/ucl_parser.c::ucl_parser_add_string_priority, including its parsing path and error propagation, are needed to determine whether a finite input reaches the reported-error branch.
